text: Planning a trip can be exciting but also a little stressful. First, you need to choose a destination and book your transport and accommodation. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try food you have never tasted before. Sometimes you face language barriers, but you can use simple words, gestures, or a translation app to communicate. These small challenges often make the journey more interesting. After you return home, you keep wonderful memories of the people you met and the places you saw. Travelling teaches you to be more open-minded and confident, and it helps you understand the world better.
